summary: Tested the Signer Portal feature end-to-end through the public deployment. Core authenticated intake CRUD, unauthenticated public GET/submit, duplicate-submit rejection, Ready-to-Journal prefill, copy actions, public token states, dashboard, journal API CRUD, and PDF export work. Backend suite result: 7 passed / 7 failed; frontend critical flow works, with one mobile layout failure and a generic SMS sender defect.

critical.issue: Completed/used public links return the full submitted data object, exposing signer address, phone, email, ID number and notes without authentication. The public status/success screen does not need this PII.
Malformed IDs such as 'not-an-object-id' return 500. Backend logs confirm uncaught bson.errors.InvalidId at ObjectId(intake_id).

Brute-force lockout is intermittent behind ingress: it failed in 3 of 4 valid runs (sixth request remained 401), while one isolated retry returned 429. request.client.host alternates between ingress addresses and splits counters.
Preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. server.py ignores CORS_ORIGINS and hardcodes allow_origins=['*'], allow_credentials=False.

minor.issue: Empty signer_name, id_type and id_number are accepted with 200 and permanently complete the intake; required string fields have no min_length validation.
A valid but nonexistent ObjectId returns 200 {'ok': true} instead of 404 because matched_count is ignored.

flaky_tests.issue: Outcome depends on which ingress client address reaches the backend; rate-limit state is split by proxy host.

integration_issues.issue: SMS always says 'this is your notary' instead of the notary's name. Neither POST/GET /api/intakes returns notary_name, although Intakes.jsx expects item.notary_name.

issues: Fixed 256px sidebar and ml-64 main content produce 703px document width in a 390px viewport.
Intakes content begins at x=296 and New Intake Link ends at x=663, making the primary action off-screen; no mobile navigation is provided.

action_items: Remove signer data from the unauthenticated public GET response; return only display/status fields.
Validate ObjectId before database calls and return controlled 400/404; check matched_count in mark-used.
Add Pydantic min_length validation for required signer fields.
Key rate limiting from a trusted forwarded client IP plus normalized email, or use an account/email-based limiter that works behind ingress.
Parse explicit CORS_ORIGINS and enable credentials instead of wildcard CORS.
Return/inject the current notary name for SMS draft generation.
Add responsive authenticated navigation/content behavior for mobile.
Retest all listed failures after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: public_submit_intake performs find_one followed by an unconditional update, so simultaneous submissions can both pass the status check; use one atomic find_one_and_update filtered by status='pending' and unexpired state.
Intakes.load and remove have no error handling, while clipboard writes are not awaited/caught and show success even if permission is denied.
server.py is 777 lines and should be split into focused auth, intake, journal, client and PDF route modules.
Several interactive controls still lack data-testid attributes, including dialog Cancel/close controls and Select options.
The requested /app/auth_testing.md playbook file is absent, so its implementation comparison could not be performed; direct requested auth checks were executed instead.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary TEST_ intakes and a regression journal entry. UI intake was marked used then deleted. Test login-attempt records were removed; no persistent test intake/journal seed remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core happy path is proven through the public URL. Re-run backend_test.py after fixes, then repeat mobile /intakes at 390px and verify SMS uses Matthew Yurksaitis. Public pending seeded token remains sU3c4C39cti1XVFBAkodwlPo; completed token mU77L1JQpluEcT0dgfkBJ-xL currently demonstrates public PII exposure.
rca_of_the_issue: Malformed IDs are passed directly to bson.ObjectId without validation; mark-used ignores update matched_count; required Pydantic strings lack constraints; public_get_intake explicitly returns doc.data; CORS is hardcoded to wildcard/no credentials; rate-limit identity uses the reverse proxy host, which varied across requests; authenticated layout uses a permanently fixed w-64 sidebar and ml-64 main area with no breakpoint behavior.
